title: Tech Note: Enhanced Tools for Reading XML Attributes
author: David Adams
featured_technology: 4th Dimension DOM XML commands (DOM Count XML attributes, DOM GET XML ATTRIBUTE BY INDEX/BY NAME)
Custom ON ERR CALL error handling
DOM_AttributesToArrays and related DOM_* attribute utility routines

historical_commentary.text: This note builds a set of enhanced utility routines on top of 4D's three native DOM attribute commands, adding automatic error handling, protection against the #document-node crash bug, name/value matching helpers, and array-conversion tools. It's a direct companion/extension to Tech Notes 06-44 and 07-04 from the same period, reusing the same defensive error-trapping pattern; the specific DOM XML API is now legacy, but the reusable utility-library approach (wrapping a fragile native API with a richer, safer, more convenient set of helper functions) remains a durable software design pattern.
related_updates: 4D added native JSON support and other modern data-interchange handling in later versions, reducing reliance on the classic DOM XML attribute commands for new development
This note's error-handling and #document special-casing approach builds directly on Tech Note 06-44, Avoiding Problems Reading DOM XML Nodes
